positions.as_written: Treat tear orientation relative to the circumferential fibres as the mechanical question.
Expect the inner third to behave more like cartilage and the outer like tendon.
Treat the fibre architecture as the thing a repair either reconstitutes or does not.
Expect repair in degenerate tissue to behave differently from repair in healthy tissue.
